item.title: A big pallet of waste has been left unattended for several months, 19th October
item.description:
A large pallet of garden waste and a second bag of waste have been left by a resident in a communal public area at the rear of Beadle House, Westbourne Road SE26 5NP. The pallet has been there for several months and poses a potential health and safety risk, as it has not been secured to prevent accidental injury. The waste is unsightly and detracts from the appearance of the communal area. It should be removed as soon as possible. Residents carrying out garden work should retain their waste within their own gardens until appropriate arrangements can be made for its removal, rather than leaving it in shared communal spaces.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Westbourne Road, Penge, Greater London
